# pg-cdc-to-files

> Write PostgreSQL logical decoding changes in wal2json format-version 2 to rotating JSONL files per table, committed transactions only, with an atomic LSN checkpoint and exactly-once resume Python package `trysac-pg-cdc-to-files`, import name `pg_cdc_to_files`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
